scripts.test: npm run generate:public && node --test --test-isolation=none tests/content.test.js tests/public-content.test.js tests/paths.test.js tests/router.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run generate:public && node --test --test-isolation=none --experimental-test-coverage tests/content.test.js tests/public-content.test.js tests/paths.test.js tests/router.test.js
scripts.build: npm run validate:content && npm run generate:public && npm run validate:public-assets && vite build && node scripts/create-spa-fallback.cjs dist
scripts.build:github: npm run validate:content && npm run generate:public && npm run validate:public-assets && vite build --base /zsy-portfolio/ --outDir dist-github && node scripts/create-spa-fallback.cjs dist-github
scripts.build:root: npm run validate:content && npm run generate:public && npm run validate:public-assets && vite build --base / --outDir dist-root && node scripts/create-spa-fallback.cjs dist-root
